# Fictional raw notes

No job title, target role or industry has been supplied. These notes are invented for a workflow trial.

## garden-note
Spring 2025. We kept forgetting who would water the shared garden when somebody was away. I drew a paper rota and asked people to put their own days on it. A neighbour agreed the final rota and arranged cover for two absences. We used it for six weeks. I don't know whether it continued after that. Nobody measured plant health or time saved.

## chair-note
2024, month not recorded. I brought a loose chair to the community workshop. I cleaned away old glue and helped clamp the joint. An experienced volunteer chose the adhesive and checked the finished repair. The chair went back into use. I would still need help choosing a repair method for another chair.

## display-note
Autumn 2025. I sketched a display for the garden open day using spare boards. Another volunteer found some boards we could use. The open day was cancelled because of bad weather, so we never built the display. I kept the sketch; there is no evidence anyone used it later.

## background-note
I've helped with these activities around other commitments. These are unpaid contributions. I haven't supplied employment dates, formal qualifications or a desired next job.
